description: This header file provides declarations for the HostIf JSON Request Handler interface in a TR-069 host interface module. It includes function prototypes for starting and stopping an HTTP server, handling JSON messages, and parsing/creating JSON objects related to host interface requests.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStart
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server for handling JSON requests.

methods.name: hostIf_HTTPJsonMsgHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON messages from HTTP client.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStop
methods.description: Stops the HTTP server handling JSON requests.
